statements.t: In addition to GrowthOS, the Company is developing BYOB as a distinct commercial product intended to extend its AI capabilities into a substantially broader range of business applications and customer markets.
Management believes this approach could reduce barriers to adoption, improve distribution efficiency, and create opportunities for recurring subscription revenue across a diversified customer base.

Importantly, BYOB is intended to extend beyond marketing and customer acquisition into broader business operations, potentially positioning the Company to participate in the growing adoption of AI-powered business productivity and automation solutions.

Management currently estimates that BYOB will require approximately two to three additional months of development before its anticipated initial commercial availability, subject to successful completion of development, integration, testing, and available resources.
The Company anticipates evaluating subscription-based pricing and additional premium service offerings as commercialization progresses.

BYOB is intended to expand the Company’s reach beyond traditional enterprise customers by providing businesses of varying sizes access to customized AI agents and automated workflows through a simplified operating environment.
The Company’s existing and anticipated revenue opportunities include:

By combining enterprise-focused customer acquisition capabilities with a broadly accessible AI-powered business operating platform, the Company intends to pursue opportunities across a significantly larger and more diversified customer market.
The Company has developed several new features which we believe will help grow revenue in 2026 and beyond.

During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company continued enhancing its AI-enabled software capabilities, expanding platform functionality, and supporting customer implementations intended to increase future recurring software and managed services revenue.
As GrowthOS™ continues to be commercialized, management expects quarterly revenue to vary based on the timing of customer deployments and program launches.
Management intends to continue investing strategically while maintaining disciplined cost management as the Company scales its software platform.
The Company has developed several new features which we believe will help grow revenue during the remainder of 2026 and beyond.

During the first nine months of 2026, the Company continued investing in AI-enabled functionality, automation capabilities, and platform enhancements intended to support future recurring software revenue and customer growth.

Management believes future growth will depend upon continued customer adoption of GrowthOS™, expansion of AI-powered customer acquisition capabilities, increased utilization of ATOS, broader deployment of CMOne, growth in recurring SaaS and managed services revenue, and continued expansion into targeted industry verticals.

Future operating results will depend on the Company's ability to continue commercializing GrowthOS™, expand customer adoption, and increase recurring revenue, although there can be no assurance that these objectives will be achieved.

Since 1999, we have relied on equity financing and borrowings from outside investors to supplement our cash flow from operations and expect this to continue in 2026 and beyond until cash flow from our proximity marketing operations becomes substantial.
